title: OPTIONAL HARDCORE SAVES AND GRAVEYARD
why: His 10-25 order: an optional hardcore save ends for good on death and joins a leaderboard ranked by stash value. Watch: a hardcore death removes that save for good; check the graveyard reads as a leaderboard with stash value as its score, and a normal save or slot 1 is never touched.
now: Choose hardcore only when creating a new save in slots 2 through 8. Death archives the career, removes its backups and returns to the save list. Graveyard ranks stash value at death.
